title: New law: A joint resolution to ensure that the compensation and other emoluments attached to the office of Secretary of the Treasury are those which were in effect on January 1, 1989. (Public Law 103-2)
summary: S.J.Res. 1 of the 103rd Congress became Public Law 103-2 on 1993-01-19.

title: New law: A joint resolution to authorize the United States Secret Service to continue to furnish protection to the former Vice President or his spouse. (Public Law 103-1)
summary: S.J.Res. 2 of the 103rd Congress became Public Law 103-1 on 1993-01-15.
